one_liner: CivicState is a paid civic-letter utility with code, but no demand or delivery proof yet.

seedPacket.basis: Root BUSINESS.md created from workspace-only repo review on 2026-06-16 [assumption: current worker runtime date].

directive: Use BUSINESS.md as the proposed business soul until operator merge/adoption; do not pitch as investible until identity, demand, deliverability, and compliance are validated.
authority: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption - operator ruling 2026-06-12 [evidence: brief instruction]; see the PR's POM record

methods: Read root and planning soul sources where present.
Compared stale planning state with current app code.
Tagged every external market claim as assumption because network was unavailable.
Used repo code and tests as evidence only for implemented surface, not market validation.

planningMethod: Bottom-up validation plan: prove identity, customer payment, official coverage, deliverability, and compliance before scale claims.

customer.definition: US residents with specific civic issues who want researched, cited, routed constituent letters [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].
segments: Renters, parents, neighborhood advocates, small business owners, and local-service complainants [assumption: civic-use-case inference].
customer.validationStatus: No workspace evidence of users, paid submissions, or conversion.

market.tam: $75,000,000 [assumption: 250,000,000 US adults x 2% paid intent x $15 AOV]
market.sam: $7,500,000 [assumption: 50,000,000 reachable civically engaged residents x 1% paid intent x $15 AOV]
market.method: Directional bottom-up model only; all population and intent figures are assumptions due to no network access.

businessModel.future: Organization dashboards and API access only after the individual paid loop works [assumption: EIR sequencing].

revenueAssumptions: Launch year paid submissions are 600 [assumption: validation scenario].
Expansion year paid submissions are 2,400 [assumption: repeatable niche GTM scenario].
Scale-test year paid submissions are 7,200 [assumption: niche product working but not venture scale].
costAssumptions: Direct COGS uses $0.60 per submission as the highest internal estimate [evidence: apps/worker/src/lib/treasury.ts].
Launch operating cost is $18,000 [assumption: low-cash operator/legal/tools budget].
Scale-test operating cost is $72,000 [assumption: support, data QA, compliance, and vendor spend].
sensitivityTests: If conversion is below 3% [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md], pause scale.
If inbox placement is below 85% [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md], stop affected delivery claims.
If chargebacks exceed 0.5% [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md], narrow use cases and revise refund policy.
If direct COGS exceeds $3.00 per submission [assumption: cost shock test], the $5 tier becomes fragile.
financialModel.summary: Launch year revenue $9,000 [assumption: 600 x $15], expansion revenue $36,000 [assumption: 2,400 x $15], scale-test revenue $108,000 [assumption: 7,200 x $15].

alternatives: Manual official email and webforms [assumption: civic workflow substitute].
Quorum, VoterVoice, FiscalNote, and Phone2Action-style platforms [assumption: category knowledge, network disabled].
General AI writing assistants [assumption: category knowledge, network disabled].

holes: Users may not pay for civic letters.
AI citation or legal-adjacent drafting risk may be unacceptable.
Official data coverage, especially local, may be incomplete.
Project identity mismatch may make the wrk.vc dossier unsafe to publish.
mitigations: Run paid beta before building more features.
Measure inbox placement, bounce rate, refunds, and complaints.
Keep citation verification, moderation, disclaimers, and human review in the critical path.
Use a narrow geography or issue category first.
Require operator confirmation of CivicState versus brooks-history identity.
residualRisks: High demand risk until paid conversion is observed.
High deliverability risk until government domains are measured.
Material compliance risk until legal review is evidenced.

strategy: Treat as a validation candidate: prove a narrow paid letter loop before adding enterprise, community, certified mail, or automated follow-up features.

goToMarket.firstCustomers: Founder-led outreach to local forums, neighborhood groups, civic newsletters, tenant/renter communities, and issue-specific groups [assumption: EIR GTM hypothesis].
goToMarket.primaryFunnel: Issue form, research preview, letter preview, checkout, delivery status [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md; apps/web/components/wizard/letter-preview.tsx].
goToMarket.channelSequence: Manual outreach first, SEO second, paid acquisition only after conversion and deliverability data [assumption: EIR sequencing].

operatorWorkflow.daily: Review flagged submissions, delivery failures, treasury reconciliation, and official opt-outs [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/admin.ts; apps/worker/src/lib/treasury.ts].
operatorWorkflow.constraints: No 24/7 staffing [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]; operator handles exceptions within 24 hours [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].

constraints: Registry says watchlist personal/research asset, not near-term investible [evidence: dispatch registry note].
Network unavailable; all external market claims are assumptions.

Civic/legal-adjacent content requires moderation, citation verification, disclaimers, and likely legal review [evidence: apps/api/src/lib/moderation.ts; apps/worker/src/agents/researcher.ts; apps/web/app/terms/page.tsx].

rules: Researcher may only cite provided search results [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/researcher.ts].
Drafter includes AI disclosure and not-legal-advice disclaimer [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/drafter.ts].
Threats and risky content go through moderation and admin review [evidence: apps/api/src/lib/moderation.ts; apps/api/src/routes/admin.ts].

unknowns: Whether this repo should be CivicState or brooks-history.
Whether users pay after seeing the preview.
Whether government official email delivery works at acceptable rates.
Whether local official data is complete enough for the core job.
Whether legal/compliance review supports live paid operation.

assumptionLedger.evidenceOrAssumption: $5 to $25 pricing [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/payments.ts]; willingness to pay is unvalidated [assumption].

assumptionLedger.claim: Market can support a small paid utility.
assumptionLedger.test: Monthly paid submissions and repeat behavior.
Compare actual ledger costs to estimates.
